evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/reports/mod.rs:363-397 (generate_sync_csv_report, faults branch) — writes user-controlled fields (status.status, cat.category, priority.priority) into CSV cells via bare `csv.push_str(&format!(...))` with NO escaping. The voting branch (line 422) only does `v.title.replace(',', ";")`, which mangles data and still ignores embedded newlines, double-quotes, and leading `=`/`+`/`-`/`@`.

Two concrete defects: (1) CSV/formula injection — a fault category or vote title beginning with `=`,`+`,`-`,`@` executes as a spreadsheet formula when the exported report is opened in Excel/LibreOffice/Sheets; these values are created by org members and flow straight into the export. (2) Broken quoting — a category/status containing a comma or newline shifts columns and corrupts the CSV (the faults branch does not even do the comma replacement).

The repo ALREADY has the correct pattern in sibling exporters: `escape_csv_field` at backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/organizations/settings.rs:588, `escape_csv` at backend/crates/integrations/src/accounting.rs, and `csv::Writer` at backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/admin/audit.rs:259. reports/mod.rs is the unescaped outlier. Fix: route all cells through `csv::Writer`/`escape_csv_field` and neutralize leading formula characters.

Reachability: sync export path guarded by `format == "csv"` at reports/mod.rs:1097; export handler is production-mounted and org-scoped (IDOR check present at :1064). Delivered base64-encoded with content_type text/csv (line ~1126).

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/layout/resolved.rs:36-41 — the `err500` closure embeds the raw error into the client-facing 500 body: `format!("db error: {e}")` (lines 82,88,92,107,115), `format!("stored published config invalid: {e}")` (98), `format!("stored manifest invalid: {e}")` (110), `format!("stored tenant override invalid: {e}")` (123). The raw sqlx/serde `{e}` (which can carry SQL fragments, column names, and stored-config structure) is returned to the caller AND is never logged server-side.

This directly contradicts the security pattern its own sibling files document and enforce: tenant.rs:27-32 and admin.rs:26-37 define `internal_error` specifically so that it `tracing::error!`s the real error server-side and returns a generic "internal server error" — the doc comment states 'raw sqlx/serde error text never leaks'. resolved.rs is the single handler in the layout module that bypasses this convention.

Impact: information disclosure of internal DB/serialization error detail to authenticated org users on a production endpoint (GET /api/v1/layout/resolved/{screen}, mounted with AuthUser), plus loss of server-side error observability. Fix: reuse the module `internal_error` helper (log server-side, return opaque message) instead of the local `err500` that interpolates `{e}`.
